purpose: Hard-cases split (F31) after the adjudication screen (F30). Mined from adapter failures in the mining slice only (D29); never router data.
rule: quarantine when an independent model gives the same alternative answer as the adapter against the gold label, on tasks where that carries signal (D36)
rejected_rule: PRD §9 literal — quarantine when the frontier also rejects gold. Confounded by selection: hard cases are chosen for difficulty, so a second miss is expected rather than evidence of a bad label.
cost: none — reuses the escalation arm's frontier answers on the mining slice

drafting.reason: gold is a reference reply; there is no label to dispute

intent.reason: 77 classes: two independent errors coincide by chance about once in 76

pii.reason: span conventions dominate — frontier disagreement measures convention, not labels

urgency.reason: 3 classes: once both models are wrong, coinciding is near a coin flip
